title: Add NotificationArea=true to more widgets so they can optionally live in the System Tray
line: Dictionary, Calculator and Konsole Profiles can now be put in the System Tray from its settings, like Kate Sessions.
explanation: The System Tray only offers widgets whose metadata has an X-Plasma-NotificationAreaCategory. Of the reporter's list, Kate Sessions already had it, Calendar, Quick Share, KDevelop Sessions and the Search widget no longer exist, and Dictionary, Calculator and Konsole Profiles still lacked it, so they could only sit directly on a panel. The change gives those three the ApplicationStatus category (the same as Kate Sessions); they keep EnabledByDefault off, so they appear in the tray settings as "Never show (disabled)" until the user enables them.

commits.message:
applets: let Dictionary, Calculator and Konsole Profiles be in the tray

These icon-only widgets could only live directly on a panel, unlike Kate
Sessions. Give them a Notification Area category so they show up in the
System Tray settings, disabled by default, and can be put in the tray.

BUG: 358283

Subject: [PATCH] applets: let Dictionary, Calculator and Konsole Profiles be
 in the tray

These icon-only widgets could only live directly on a panel, unlike Kate

System Tray settings, disabled by default, and can be put in the tray.

 applets/dict/metadata.json            | 3 ++-

diff --git a/applets/calculator/metadata.json b/applets/calculator/metadata.json
index 184c4fd19..065bd9bdb 100644
--- a/applets/calculator/metadata.json
+++ b/applets/calculator/metadata.json
@@ -155,5 +155,6 @@

         "Website": "https://kde.org/plasma-desktop/"
     },
-    "X-Plasma-API-Minimum-Version": "6.0"
+    "X-Plasma-API-Minimum-Version": "6.0",
+    "X-Plasma-NotificationAreaCategory": "ApplicationStatus"
 }

+    "X-Plasma-NotificationAreaCategory": "ApplicationStatus"
 }
